section_title: 4.1 Agroforestry Model: Ailanthus based Agri-silvicultural System under Rainfed Conditions
summary: This agroforestry model describes the cultivation of Ailanthus excelsa (Ardusa) in an agri-silvicultural system under rainfed conditions, primarily in arid and semi-arid regions of India. The system involves intercropping with pulses like green gram, cowpea, and cluster bean, which provides annual income and improves soil properties compared to sole cropping.

heading_path: 4.1 Agroforestry Model: Ailanthus based Agri-silvicultural System under Rainfed Conditions
passages.text: Ailanthus excelsa grows well in semi-arid and semi-moist regions and has been found suitable for planting in dry areas with annual rainfall of about 400 mm. It is commonly found in mixed deciduous forests and some sal forests, but it is difficult to cultivate in moist areas with high monsoons. Plant associations include Acacia catechu, Acacia leucophloea and Azadirachta indica. It is a relatively salt-tolerant species.

passages.text: Spacing: 5 x 5 m under rainfed conditions and as a block and boundary plantation the spacing should be 3 x 3 m. Pit size: Optimum size of pit is 30 x 30 x 30 cm, planting should be done during rainy season.

heading_path: 4.1 Agroforestry Model: Ailanthus based Agri-silvicultural System under Rainfed Conditions
passages.text: The Ardu tree is fast growing and normally does not require organic or inorganic fertilizers in plantations but in the arid regions of the country and in sandy soils, nitrogenous fertilizer application has given good response. Application of 100 g urea or 5 kg FYM or 1 kg vermicompost is required in the first year of growth and in subsequent years the increment of urea, i.e. 100 g per plant each year and the highest up to 500 gm and the increment of FYM @ 1 kg per plant per year and the highest amount up to 10 kg per plant. The optimum time for fertilization is onset of the monsoon.

heading_path: 4.1 Agroforestry Model: Ailanthus based Agri-silvicultural System under Rainfed Conditions
passages.text: Trees are pollarded after the third year of establishment, which increases the light intensity to the intercrops and also the growth of Ardusa will be better.

heading_path: 4.1 Agroforestry Model: Ailanthus based Agri-silvicultural System under Rainfed Conditions
passages.text: The physical and chemical properties of soil improved significantly under agri-silvi system of agroforestry as compared to sole crops. Significant improvement in organic carbon, N, P2O5, K2O, porosity and water-holding capacity of soil while significant decrease in bulk density of soil was obtained under agrisilvi system over sole crops.
